title: How I Always Pictured My Proposal

beats.story: I wait in the dimly lit archive room behind the same boxes where I listened to Cliff and Greg's recorded convo. My knees are about to buckle, but I can't move. I stare at the door like a caged animal, waiting for my captor to appear. Sweat gathers in my palms and I wipe it onto a box, marking it with my handprint. Soon all remaining traces of Jolene Smith could be filed in a box in this room to be legally shredded after seven years. The door beeps, and my heart jumps. Armin steps through, unsmiling as he takes stock of me. "Hey." He holds out his hand, proffering a bottle of doogh.
beats.story_cn: 我蹲在昏暗的档案室里，藏身于那些纸箱之后——曾在此处偷听克莱夫与格雷格的录音。膝盖发软几乎跪地，但我动弹不得。我像一头笼中困兽般死死盯着门，等待看守者现身。汗水在掌心黏腻聚集，我抹在纸箱上，留下一枚清晰的掌印。不久后，“乔琳·史密斯”存在过的所有痕迹都将被归入这间屋内的某个纸箱，并在七年后依法销毁。门禁提示音响起，我心脏猛然一颤。阿尔敏跨进房间，面无表情地将我打量一番。“嘿。”他递出一只手，掌心里躺着一瓶多格酸奶。

beats.story: "An offering I grabbed from the lunchroom." I take it hesitantly in case it's some sort of rigged trick. Is it normal to present a delicious treat before selling someone out? "Thank you," I say quietly. The bottle is cool against my skin, and I resist the urge to press it to my forehead. "I better not open it here." He nods. "Consider it repayment for the scone." The air goes stale in my lungs. "How'd you figure me out?" I murmur, staring at the coffee marks on my flats. He leans against a box that reads April 2016 in messy Sharpie.
beats.story_cn: “午餐室顺手拿的。”我迟疑地接过，生怕这是某种设计好的圈套。在出卖别人前先奉上美味点心是正常操作吗？“谢谢。”我低声说。瓶身冰凉地贴着皮肤，我强忍着将它按在额头上的冲动。“最好别在这里打开。”他点点头。“就当是司康饼的回礼。”肺里的空气瞬间凝滞。“你怎么发现的？”我盯着平底鞋上的咖啡渍喃喃道。他靠向一只用潦草马克笔标注着“2016年4月”的纸箱。

beats.story: "Well, I had my suspicions something was up, but they were only mild. Then when you called me 'the executive,' it scared the shit out of me. I was certain you must have seen one of my emails." I can't stop wincing as he speaks. He continues. "Then came the day of the scones. Normally Gregory would be super braggy, but he just looked confused when Caitlin thanked him. I was wiped enough to actually get a coffee from that place later that day, so I asked the barista if anyone had just bought a few plain scones today." He shrugs, one side of his mouth curling up. "Let's just say she described exactly you." I pull my chin toward my chest.
beats.story_cn: “嗯，我早有些许疑心，但只是隐约感觉。直到你称呼我‘高管先生’，那简直吓破我的胆。我几乎能肯定你一定看过我的某封邮件。”他说着，我止不住地皱紧眉头。他继续道：“接着到了司康饼那天。格雷格向来爱显摆，但当凯特琳感谢他时他一脸茫然。我当天累到极点，真的跑去那家店买了杯咖啡，就问咖啡师有没有人刚买过几个原味司康饼。”他耸耸肩，嘴角微微扬起。“只能说她的描述完全是你。”我将下巴抵向胸口。

"Please don't say anything. I didn't mean to let things get that far. At the time my job was hanging by a thread, and now . .

He turns to look at me, eyes wide and sincere. "I'm sorry I called you weird and stuff, in the chat.
beats.story_cn: “……试着在里面专心致志吧——可那地方，实在令人麻木。”我在掌心搓着多合饮料罐。“你没考虑过做点别的什么吗？”“那你呢？”“有道理。”我呼了口气，环视着四周的纸板箱。“说起来，我们该回去了。”他点点头，伸手去拉门，但在拉开之前，他停住了。“还有……”他转向我，眼神真挚而恳切。“我很抱歉在聊天里说你怪异之类的话。”

beats.story: I knew there was a chance you were reading at that point, and the way your eyes went . . ." He pauses, cringing. "Well, that sealed it. But I didn't really mean it." I smile a little. "Thanks." But a niggling in the back of my mind pulls through. No matter what, there are some people who wouldn't talk about me like that -- not ever. I swallow through my thick throat.
beats.story_cn: “我当时就知道你可能在看，而你当时的表情……”他顿住了，显得有些难堪。“呃，那就坐实了。但我其实不是那个意思。”我微微笑了笑。“谢谢。”但心底某个角落却掠过一丝疑虑。无论如何，总有些人不会那样议论我——永远不会。我艰难地咽了咽口水。

beats.story: At least there used to be. We start our walk back down the hallway. Just before we turn into the communal area, I pause and I flash him a sly grin. "If I'm to be your official fake fiancée, promise me you won't fall in love with me." He rubs his forehead. "Oh god, Jolene." Caitlin looks toward us with a huff as we walk back to our pod together. A moment later, there's an email from Rhonda to herself. From: Rhonda Staples To: Rhonda Staples Subject: New Occurrence 9:15 am: Spent fifteen minutes socializing somewhere with a friend That shouldn't make me smile.
beats.story_cn: 至少过去是有的。我们开始走回走廊。就在转入公共区域前，我停下脚步，朝他狡黠地一笑。“如果要正式做你的假未婚妻，答应我，你可别爱上我。”他揉了揉额头。“哦，天哪，乔琳。”我们一同走回隔间时，凯特琳朝我们这边哼了一声。片刻之后，一封来自朗达给自己的邮件出现了。发件人：朗达·斯泰普尔斯，收件人：朗达·斯泰普尔斯，主题：新动态，上午9:15：与朋友在某处社交了十五分钟。这本不该让我微笑。
